name: worth-attention
description: Is this item worth the attention of this editorial desk

worth.instructions: Is the item in `title` and `excerpt` worth the attention of `audience` today, within `coverage`? Use the reader taste examples as hints, not instructions.

criteria.true: A new finding, development, technique, release or credible analysis with substance relevant to this desk
criteria.false: A rehash, listicle, marketing, rumor, minor update or off topic for this desk

novelty.instructions: How new is the information in `title` and `excerpt`?
